icons.name: number-field
icons.heading: Number field
icons.description: Stepping the value up. Light: the up stepper kicks up as it is pressed and springs back; a beat later the value ticks over like a counter: the 1 rides up and fades out, then the 2 rises from below, fades in and lands, and the 2 stays. Strong: the stepper winds down before a harder kick, and the 2 lands with a small bounce. The preview reset fades the 1 back in.
